settings.label: Server name
settings.description: The name in the game's server browser.

settings.label: Description
settings.description: Shown under the name in the server browser.

settings.label: Tags
settings.description: Words players can search the server browser for, separated by commas.

settings.label: Public
settings.description: List the server on Factorio's public server browser. Needs a factorio.com username and token.

settings.label: LAN
settings.description: Announce the server to players on the same network.

settings.label: Game password
settings.description: Players need it to join. Empty means no password.

settings.label: Require a factorio.com account
settings.description: Only let in players whose factorio.com account checks out. Turning it off lets anyone in under any name.

settings.label: Max players
settings.description: How many players can be on at once. 0 is no limit. Admins can always join.

settings.label: Let returning players past the limit
settings.description: Players who have played this map before can join even when it is full.

settings.label: Username
settings.description: The factorio.com account the server lists itself with. Prism Factorio also uses it to download mods.

settings.label: Token
settings.description: The token from factorio.com/profile (not the password). It is never shown again once saved.

settings.label: Console commands
settings.description: Who may use console commands and Lua in the game. Using them turns achievements off for the map.

settings.label: Only admins can pause
settings.description: Whether only admins may pause the game.

settings.label: Pause when empty
settings.description: Pause the game while nobody is on.

settings.label: Pause while someone joins
settings.description: Pause while a player is downloading the map to join.

settings.label: Kick idle players after (minutes)
settings.description: Kick players who do nothing for this long. 0 never kicks.

settings.label: Save
settings.description: The save in the saves folder the server opens, without .zip. A name with no save makes a new map on the next start, with the map settings in data/map-gen-settings.json.

settings.label: Autosave every (minutes)
settings.description: How often the server saves the map.

settings.label: Autosave slots
settings.description: How many autosaves are kept before the oldest is overwritten.

settings.label: Autosave only on the server
settings.description: Players' games do not save a copy too.

settings.label: Save without pausing
settings.description: Experimental: saves in the background so play does not stop. Factorio warns saves may be lost.

settings.label: Max upload (KB/s)
settings.description: Limits how fast the map is sent to joining players. 0 is no limit.

settings.label: Map downloads at once
settings.description: How many players can download the map at the same time. 0 is no limit.

settings.label: Minimum latency (ticks)
settings.description: A tick is about 16 ms. 0 means no minimum.

settings.label: Network tick rate
settings.description: How many updates a second the server sends before bundling them. From 6 to 240.

settings.label: Minimum segment size
settings.description: Smallest piece long messages are split into. Changing it can hurt connection stability.

settings.label: Maximum segment size
settings.description: Largest piece long messages are split into. Changing it can hurt connection stability.
